case.question: What is the maximum input voltage?
case.expected_behavior: Scope unclear: bare module VBAT max 4.5 V vs EVK 5 V input; ask which.

result.question: What is the maximum input voltage?
result.answer: This depends on what you are powering. Bare module: The maximum input voltage for the VBAT_BB (pins 32, 33) and VBAT_RF (pins 52, 53) power supply of the C16QS module is 4.5V [HW-v5.3-p027-2]. This is also confirmed in the power consumption characteristics table, which lists the maximum input voltage as 4.5V [HW-v5.3-p060-2]. EVK board: The Cavli C16QS EVK board supports power input via a 5V, 2A DC power adapter [EVK-v1.1-p013-1]. Additionally, the board can be powered via the USB Type-C interface [EVK-v1.1-p012-1]. Jumper 3 (JMP 3) is used to switch between these two voltage sources, specifically the USB Type-C and the +5V Adapter [EVK-v1.1-p012-1].
result.clarification: Do you mean the bare C16QS module (VBAT) or the C16QS EVK board input?
